title: Comparison Geometry on Manifolds with Density via Modified Hessians
summary: Comparison geometry for Bakry-Émery Ricci curvature has been extensively developed by Wei-Wylie and others. Motivated by the weighted sectional curvature framework introduced by Wylie and further developed by Kennard-Wylie-Yeroshkin, we study radial comparison geometry on manifolds with density through a modified Hessian arising from this framework. Under nonnegative weighted sectional curvature together with suitable density control assumptions, we obtain a modified Hessian estimate for the radial function $u = \frac{1}{2}r^2$.
